purpose: Choose locally deployable retrieval improvements with fixed real-case relevance; no paid APIs; no production change
implementation: Pinned official weights, Transformers reference pooling/prompts, no remote Python code; GPU float32/float16 smoke profiling chooses finite faster precision before accuracy scores
development_queries: Existing 100 recent English plus existing 32 Korean and their 32 original English source titles. Previously inspected; not final test.
development_corpus: 5000 real documents: all development gold targets plus deterministic SHA256(v3-pool:ID) distractors from the unchanged v2 recent full corpus. Controlled screening pool, not deployed full-corpus accuracy.
embedding_input: same title + newline + body, max_length=256 per model tokenizer; model-specific required query/document prefixes. Content truncation may differ by tokenizer and is recorded, not claimed as architecture-only ablation.
reranker_screening: same baseline dense top50 candidates per query; max_length=512; compare with no reranking; official sequence-classification or yes/no logit scoring, not free-form LLM judge
selection_score: 0.5 * recent English nDCG@10 + 0.5 * historical Korean-control nDCG@10; English source controls diagnostic only. Equal groups are a chosen product priority, not measured traffic proportions.
resources: Profile 32 representative items first; full 47k-document embedding expansion only if estimated <=90 minutes per finalist; local failures/time gates recorded, never counted as accuracy losses. Peak memory and latency measured.
chunking_probe: For leading feasible embedding, compare head-only document with head+tail max256-token vectors, max score per source document and deduplicate before metrics. Bounded tail-coverage probe, not full-document chunking.
combination: Compare best feasible embedding without reranker, with each feasible reranker; compare dense candidates and dense+BM25 union using same reranker. Choose on development only.
final_test: Collect later real ServerFault duplicate cases before new model accuracy scores; community original_questions IDs are gold. Candidate background includes source records; source query itself excluded. Model parameters and selected pipeline locked before final score; report holdout by domain/language and uncertainty.
statistics: Paired query bootstrap 2000 seed20261118; exploratory development comparisons; final report effect and CI, no tune on final labels/ranks
limitations: public-model training overlap cannot be fully ruled out
5000 candidate screening differs from full 47k corpus
GPU coexistence with answer LLM must be assessed before deployment
